pages.text:
An engine-generator set: it burns liquid and gas fuels straight to FE, a mid-game step below the Gas Turbine Array.
# Building
A solid box of Diesel Generator Casings 3 wide and 3 tall, with the Diesel Generator Controller in the middle of the bottom of one end, facing out. Its length sets the engine:
- 5 long: a V8, 3,000 FE/t.
- 7 long: a V12, 8,000 FE/t, 5% more FE per mB.
- 9 long: a V16, 15,000 FE/t, 10% more FE per mB.
Its fuel tank grows with its length (16,000 mB on the V8) and its FE buffer with its output.

Formed, it becomes a big genset on a base frame over its fuel tank: the radiator and fan at the front, the V engine with a rocker cover per cylinder, its turbochargers (four on the V16) and silencer, the flywheel housing, and the alternator with its terminal box and control panel.

# Running
It runs up to speed over 3 seconds, then makes its engine's full output. When its FE buffer fills it throttles back to what's drawn, burning only the fuel for that. Sour fuels are refused.
| Fuel | FE/mB (V8 / V12 / V16) | mB/t at full power |
| Diesel | 420 / 441 / 462 | 7.1 / 18.1 / 32.5 |
| Gasoline | 400 / 420 / 440 | 7.5 / 19.0 / 34.1 |
| Kerosene | 360 / 378 / 396 | 8.3 / 21.2 / 37.9 |
| Biodiesel | 340 / 357 / 374 | 8.8 / 22.4 / 40.1 |
| Refinery Gas | 240 / 252 / 264 | 12.5 / 31.7 / 56.8 |
# Ports
- Input: fuel in (liquid or gas).
- Energy: FE out, pushed to what it touches (16,384 FE/t a port).
The fuels are data-driven (arcforge:engine_fuels); the outputs and efficiencies are in config.
